nanoReadyBg.message: Gemini Nano is ready (confirmed in background context).

nanoHintDownloadable.message: {status}: click “Download Gemini Nano” below to enable it

nanoHintUnavailable.message: {status}: usually the model is not downloaded or hardware is insufficient — try “Download Gemini Nano” first. If it still fails, open chrome://components and find “Optimization Guide Manifest Component: nano_v3_gpu_component” (the one with nano in the name), click “Check for update” until status becomes Up-to-date. If it stays unchanged, hardware may be insufficient (>4GB VRAM, or 16GB RAM + 4 cores) or less than 22GB disk space is available.

selftestRunning.message: Running self-test (creating models in both contexts, may take a few seconds)…

selftestNoResult.message: No self-test result. See raw output below.

selftestOkLocal.message: ✅ This language pair can be created in the side panel.

selftestOkBgFailed.message: but creation failed in background (Chrome only allows creation in a document with user gesture) — the extension will automatically use offscreen document / Gemini Nano and should work normally.

selftestLocalFailed.message: ⚠️ Creation also failed in the side panel:

selftestLocalFailedExplain.message: This means the language pack for this pair is unavailable on the Chrome side (availability is only a capability query and Chrome intentionally obscures language pack status).

selftestNanoOkSuggest.message: Gemini Nano works on this device → consider switching to the Gemini Nano engine above; translation/explanation will still work.

selftestNanoBadSuggest.message: Gemini Nano is also unavailable. Check chrome://on-device-internals and hardware requirements.

selftestExtraSuggest.message: Also try: chrome://components → Chrome TranslateKit “Check for update”, and chrome://flags/#translation-api set to “Enabled without language pack limit”.

dlPairRejected.message: Chrome refused to create a translator instance for this language pair.

dlHint1.message: ① Use now: switch to Gemini Nano (ready on this device), translation is unaffected.

dlHint2.message: ② Check language pack: open chrome://components in a new tab → find Chrome TranslateKit → click “Check for update”.

dlHint3.message: ③ Remove pair limit: chrome://flags/#translation-api → choose Enabled without language pack limit → restart Chrome (ignore if flag is unavailable).

dlHint4.message: ④ Try another pair (e.g. English → Japanese): if only this pair fails, it’s a language pack issue, not an extension issue.

nanoNotReadyTitle.message: Gemini Nano is not ready. Check in order:

nanoHintStep1.message: ① Click “Open chrome://components” below → find Optimization Guide Manifest Component: nano_v3_gpu_component (name contains nano) → click “Check for update” until status changes from New to Up-to-date (~2GB).

nanoHintStep2.message: ② Ensure chrome://flags/#prompt-api-for-gemini-nano (if present) is Enabled and restart browser.

nanoHintStep3.message: ③ Hardware requirements: >4GB VRAM, or 16GB RAM + 4+ cores; at least 22GB free disk space.

nanoHintStep4.message: ④ Click “Open on-device-internals” below → check Model Status for specific errors.

probeHint3.message: · “characters read = 0” but has target → element detected but text unreadable (often a special rich-text editor).

engineErrNoApi.message: Translator API is not available in this environment (requires Chrome 138+ desktop; mobile is not supported).

engineErrNoNano.message: Gemini Nano (Prompt API) is not available in this environment. Common causes: ① model not downloaded — "Optimization Guide On Device Model" in chrome://components must exist and be up to date; ② hardware requirements not met (>4GB VRAM, or 16GB RAM + 4+ cores); ③ Chrome version too old. If hardware/version are fine, click "Let Chrome download Gemini Nano" in the side panel to trigger download.

engineErrNeedGesture.message: First use requires downloading a language pack/model. Click the button to confirm download.

engineErrUnsupportedPair.message: Chrome built-in models do not support this language pair.

engineErrMtpSampling.message: Gemini Nano session creation failed: Chrome enabled MTP speculative decoding and requires compatible sampling parameters. The extension already retried with compatible parameters; if it still fails, click "Reset engine" in the side panel and try again.

engineErrPairCreateFailed.message: Chrome refused to create a translation instance for this language pair: availability() reported available, but create() returned NotSupportedError. Common causes: create() was not executed in a document with user gesture (e.g. called from extension background/worker), or the Chrome TranslateKit language pack does not enable this pair.

engineErrSameLanguage.message: Source and target languages are the same; no translation needed.

engineErrQuota.message: Text exceeds model input quota and still failed after chunking.

engineErrDownloadFailed.message: Model download failed. Check network (non-metered connection required) or try again later.

engineErrGenericFailure.message: Chrome built-in translation engine reported an internal error (Other generic failures occurred.) — usually the language pack state is abnormal or the translation session expired. The extension will automatically rebuild and retry once; if it still fails, click "Reset local session (try when translation errors occur)" in the side panel, then check/update Chrome components in chrome://components and retry.

engineErrBusy.message: Model is busy, please try again later.
